name: List invoices
description:
##  GET /api/v1/invoices

Lists invoices with the option to chain multiple query parameters allowing fine grained filtering of the list.
whenToUse: Fetch and filter many invoices by client, status, number, date, or overdue with pagination; use to search or list, not to read one by id.

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```

queryParameters.name: per_page
queryParameters.description: The number of records to return for each request, default is 20

queryParameters.name: page
queryParameters.description: The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1

queryParameters.name: sort
queryParameters.description:
Order the list by choosing a column and direction. Each value uses the form `column|asc` or `column|desc`.

*Single sort** — for example `sort=balance|desc`.

*Multiple sorts** — use `sort[]` for each level in priority order, for example
`sort[]=id|desc&sort[]=number|asc`.

Invoices accept columns on the `invoices` table, relationship-style keys such as `client.name`, `client_id`, `documents`, `project_id`, and prefixed `client.*` / `contact.*` sorts where the filter supports them. `number` and `status_id` have special handling. Unsupported keys are ignored.

queryParameters.name: status
queryParameters.description:
Filter the entity based on their status. ie active / archived / deleted. Format is a comma separated string with any of the following options:
- active
- archived
- deleted

```html
GET /api/v1/invoices?status=archived,deleted
Returns only archived and deleted invoices
```

queryParameters.name: client_id
queryParameters.description:
Filters the entity list by client_id. Suitable when you only want the entities of a specific client.

```html
GET /api/v1/invoices?client_id=AxB7Hjk9
Returns only invoices for the specified client
```

queryParameters.name: created_at
queryParameters.description:
Filters the entity list by the created at timestamp. Parameter value can be a datetime string or unix timestamp

```html
GET /api/v1/invoices?created_at=2022-01-10
Returns entities created on January 10th, 2022
```

queryParameters.name: updated_at
queryParameters.description:
Filters the entity list by the updated at timestamp. Parameter value can be a datetime string or unix timestamp

```html
GET /api/v1/invoices?updated_at=2022-01-10
Returns entities last updated on January 10th, 2022
```

queryParameters.name: is_deleted
queryParameters.description:
Filters the entity list by entities that have been deleted.

```html
GET /api/v1/invoices?is_deleted=true
Returns only soft-deleted entities
```

queryParameters.name: filter_deleted_clients
queryParameters.description:
Filters the entity list and only returns entities for clients that have not been deleted

```html
GET /api/v1/invoices?filter_deleted_clients=true
Returns only invoices for active (non-deleted) clients
```

queryParameters.name: vendor_id
queryParameters.description:
Filters the entity list by an associated vendor

```html
GET /api/v1/purchases?vendor_id=AxB7Hjk9
Returns only purchases for the specified vendor
```

queryParameters.name: client_status
queryParameters.description:
A comma separated list of invoice status strings. Valid options include:
- all
- paid
- unpaid
- overdue

queryParameters.name: number
queryParameters.description: Search invoices by invoice number

queryParameters.name: filter
queryParameters.description:
Searches across a range of columns including:
- number
- po_number
- date
- amount
- balance
- custom_value1
- custom_value2
- custom_value3
- custom_value4
- client.name
- client.contacts.[first_name, last_name, email]
- line_items.[product_key, notes]

queryParameters.name: without_deleted_clients
queryParameters.description: Returns the invoice list without the invoices of deleted clients.

queryParameters.name: overdue
queryParameters.description: Returns the list of invoices that are overdue

queryParameters.name: payable
queryParameters.description: Returns the invoice list that are payable for a defined client. Please note, you must pass the client_id as the value for this query parameter

queryParameters.name: private_notes
queryParameters.description: Searches on the private_notes field of the invoices

queryParameters.name: date
queryParameters.description: Filters the invoices by invoice date returns a list of invoices after (and including) the date

queryParameters.name: date_range
queryParameters.description: Filters the invoices by invoice date returns a list of invoices between two dates

queryParameters.name: status_id
